meaning: the reviewed obligation set (id, revision, meaning digest, relevant digest), the reviewed residual set (variant, path, classification, digest), the judged population (per binding: its entry's admission, every recording with its native stream hash, every occurrence id) and the frozen debt by exact finding identity (category and id) with its reason. CanonicalConformanceTest fails on a new finding, on frozen debt that no longer occurs, and on any changed obligation, residual or population: an edit here is the reviewable change, never its approval. Holding the baseline is not acceptance: category 6 keeps the semantic review state
